Nora (CSM): Quick alert  BrightBridge (mid-market, ~130 seats) active usage down ~44% last 30d, renewal in 18 days. I'm proposing a short "safeguard corridor": 12-day focused ops + 48h infra trial + optional 30-day seat-hold with conditional uplift credits. Keep it reversible. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Clara (CS Ops): Health funnel shows heavy drop at 'integration complete' step. Exported task trace + heatmap here: https://go.redwood/brightbridge-heatmap :mag_right:

Zane (AE): I can run an exec reset Fri 9:30am PT. Need a single crisp promise we can make on the call (e.g., estimated token spend reduction if caching + batching applied).

Ivy (SE): Config note  their Dedicated cluster has prefix_cache disabled and batching conservative. 48h canary should show clear delta. Plan below.

Ivy (SE): ```
Canary plan (48h):
- toggle: prefix_cache=true on canary-pool-2
- batching: max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat routes
- monitor: tokens/session, p50/p95 latency, error rate
- extra: enable kv_cache_eviction=auto during trial to stabilize results
- rollback: `safeguard_rb.sh` to revert toggles quickly
```

Marta (Product): If CS can surface 4 representative failing prompts or sessions we'll repro on staging and check for reranker/model mismatch. Also ask customer for timestamps when performance felt worst so we can correlate.

Nora (CSM): Draft safeguard corridor (12 days):
- Day 0: Exec reset call + signoff for 48h canary (Zane/Ivy)
- Days 1-5: Two hands-on enablement labs (30-45m) for power users + integrators (Ivy/Nora)
- Days 3-7: Collect up to 5 failing prompts & sample logs (Nora owns)
- Days 8-10: Present trial results + product findings; offer seat-hold (30 days) with preserved data OR 12% credit on next invoice if they commit to 6-month renewal (commercial: Zane)
- Day 12: Close or extend to 30-day recovery plan depending on adoption metrics

Clara (CS Ops): Can we also attach a 2-question micro-survey after each enablement: 1) "Immediate unblock? (Y/N)" 2) "Top friction area (select): onboarding / API / model outputs / other"  will capture structured input to feed product. I'll stub form and link.

Zane (AE): For commercial baseline I need 30/60/90 usage and last 3 invoices. Nora  can you attach? Also need a conservative estimate for token spend reduction to present on the exec call.

Nora (CSM): Pulling invoices now and will upload to the shared plan doc. Suggested conservative talking point: "expected token spend reduction in the 15-25% range if caching + batching applied conservatively."

ops-bot: Meeting created  "BrightBridge exec reset" Fri 9:30 AM PT (invite sent)

Ivy (SE): I'll run the 48h canary starting Fri 10:30am PT after the call and post results here (median/95p latency, tokens/session, any error spikes). If token spend drops >20% we should present that as a negotiable lever. :+1:

Marta (Product): Will standby to triage any captured prompts. If we see model mismatch we can repro on staging within 24h and advise whether a variant rollback or prompt adjustments needed.

Clara (CS Ops): I'll prepare the micro-survey and the Calendly for enablement slots. Also will add a small cost/savings calc sheet for Zane to show on the exec call.

Nora (CSM): Owners & immediate next steps:
- Zane: Exec call Fri 9:30am PT (prep bullets by Thu EOD)
- Ivy: 48h canary Fri 10:30am PT
- Clara: Micro-survey + scheduling links by Thu EOD
- Nora: Invoices + usage upload by Thu EOD; collect failing prompts by next Tue
- Zane: Draft seat-hold language & conditional credit terms by Thu EOD

Zane (AE): Roger. I'll prepare a short slide with a conservative savings estimate and the seat-hold language.

Nora (CSM): If this goes well I'll add a compact template called `safeguard-corridor` to micro-saves for re-use. Next updates here after exec call and post-48h canary. Thanks all.
